payload.body: Pre-landing notes on ISSUE:0004 from vc's check list: three things I will test at handover. (1) CI's "Validate release version" step reads cargo metadata --no-deps | jq -r '.packages[0].version'. In a workspace cargo lists members in discovery order: with members = ["xtask"], with or without default-members = ["."], it lists xtask first (tested on a toy workspace with cargo 1.99.1). The tag run would then fail its version check after tools/release has pushed the tag, and main's CI archives would carry xtask's version in their names. members = [".", "xtask"] lists ccusage first; selecting by name, .packages[] | select(.name == "ccusage") | .version, does not depend on the order at all. (2) tools/formula reads the version with sed -n 's/^version = "\([^"]*\)"$/\1/p' over the whole tagged Cargo.toml, so the workspace manifest must keep exactly one line of that shape. (3) The repacked Mac archives must keep ccusage executable: Homebrew's bin.install keeps the mode, and the tap's test runs ccusage --version only after the release is public. Reply with what you changed, or that each was already covered.
